questions.stem: It's important for us ____ a foreign language well.
questions.explain: It is + 形容词 + for sb. + to do sth. 句型中，it 是形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式 to learn。
questions.verify: 本单元按“不定式与动名词”编写，教材各单元的语法项目未核实；请对照教材目录核对。

questions.kp: 接不定式作宾语的动词
questions.stem: He decided ____ a job in Shanghai after graduation.
questions.explain: decide、hope、plan、agree、refuse 等动词后接不定式作宾语：decide to do sth.。

questions.stem: I'd like you ____ me with my English.
questions.explain: would like sb. to do sth.（想要某人做某事），不定式 to help 作宾语补足语，to 不能省。

questions.kp: 省略 to 的不定式
questions.stem: The teacher let the students ____ home early because of the heavy snow.
questions.explain: let、make、have 等使役动词后的宾语补足语用不带 to 的不定式：let sb. do sth.。

questions.kp: 不定式的被动式作定语
questions.stem: The meeting ____ tomorrow will discuss the new plan.
questions.explain: 会议是“被举行”的，而且发生在将来（tomorrow），用不定式的被动式 to be held 作定语。“held”作定语一般表示已经完成的被动动作。

questions.stem: He got up early ____ catch the first bus.
questions.explain: so as to / in order to 后接动词原形，表示目的；so that、in order that 后面要接完整的从句。

questions.stem: Could you tell me how ____ (use) this machine?
questions.explain: 疑问词 how / what / where 等 + 不定式，相当于一个宾语从句：how to use = how I can use。

questions.stem: The box is too heavy for the child ____ (carry).
questions.explain: too + 形容词 + (for sb.) + to do sth. 表示“太……而不能……”，用不定式。

questions.kp: 接动名词作宾语的动词
questions.stem: Would you mind ____ the window? It's a bit cold.
questions.explain: mind、enjoy、finish、suggest、practice、avoid 等动词后接动名词作宾语：mind doing sth.。

questions.kp: 介词 to 后接动名词
questions.stem: She is looking forward to ____ her family during the Spring Festival.
questions.explain: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面接名词或动名词；同类的还有 be used to、devote oneself to、pay attention to。

questions.kp: remember doing 与 remember to do
questions.stem: I remember ____ the door, but now it's open.
questions.explain: remember doing 表示“记得做过某事”（动作已发生）；remember to do 表示“记得要去做某事”（动作还没发生）。这里是记得自己锁过门。

questions.kp: remember doing 与 remember to do
questions.stem: Please remember ____ the lights when you leave the office.
questions.explain: 关灯是离开时才要做的事，还没发生，用 remember to do（记得去做）。

questions.kp: stop doing 与 stop to do
questions.stem: He stopped ____ because the doctor said it was bad for his heart.
questions.explain: stop doing 是“停止做某事”（戒烟）；stop to do 是“停下来去做另一件事”，“to smoke”会变成“停下来去抽烟”，与医生的话矛盾。

questions.kp: be used to doing 与 used to do
questions.stem: She is used to ____ up early, so it is not hard for her.
questions.explain: be used to doing 表示“习惯于做某事”，to 是介词；used to do 表示“过去常常做某事”，两者不要混淆。

questions.stem: ____ (swim) in the sea in summer is great fun.
questions.explain: 表示一般性的行为作主语时常用动名词 Swimming，谓语用单数；用不定式 To swim 作主语语法上也对。

questions.stem: Thank you for ____ (give) me so much help.
questions.explain: 介词 for 后面接动名词作宾语：thank sb. for doing sth.。
